culture.text: Around 500-600 staff (623 on LinkedIn) who call themselves 'Byndies', with eight offices including the Netherlands, USA, Spain, UK, Australia and UAE.
Staff often come from University of Amsterdam, VU Amsterdam and Erasmus, studying marketing, business or computer science.

open.text: Bynder B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Says it serves more than 1.7 million users at over 3,700 organisations, including Spotify, Puma and Icelandair.

worth_knowing.text: Dutch agency iO and Bynder teamed up to help brands scale AI-driven content operations.
